part2.question: Describe an advertisement with a famous person in it

segments.v: I want to talk about an advertisement for an energy drink. It has a famous Vietnamese footballer in it. I saw it on YouTube, on TV and on billboards in the street. In the advertisement, the footballer trains very early in the morning in the rain. He is very tired. Then he drinks the energy drink and he becomes strong. He runs fast and scores a goal in a big stadium. At the end there is a slogan. I think the advertisement is very beautiful and exciting. Many young people like it. But I don't like the message because energy drinks have a lot of sugar. They are not healthy. I think the footballer is successful because he trains hard, not because of the drink.
